what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 15798 Iraqi refugees in the United Kingdom, 5.8% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Iraq from 1983 to 1988, and armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Iraq with the KDP and PUK from 1983 to 1992.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in every year from 2004 to 2025, at war level in many of them, with the al-Mahdi Army, Ansar al-Islam, IS and RJF among the opponents.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 932 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 23420, at the end of 2003, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2001 to 2011 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
